notablePrerequisites: You are able to put a counter on War Elemental.
description:
Put a counter on War Elemental.
The Great Goblin's first ability triggers, as War Elemental is a Goblin, Orc or Army due to Psychic Paper, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
War Elemental triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Psychic Paper
uses.cardState: attached to War Elemental and with "Goblin", "Orc" or "Army" chosen
